purpose: Track volatile capability/cost/compatibility/availability claims that can become stale and must be rechecked before they drive routing or user-facing claims.

entries.claim: HTTP_JSON_V1 sync adapter exists and is runtime-verified, but no production backend endpoint is configured.
recheck_trigger: before claiming cloud sync is available
before routing production data through remote sync
after Ready-Set deployment or sync configuration change
entries.fallback: Remain LOCAL_ONLY and keep Outbox pending; do not claim production cloud synchronization.
